title: Choosing a Vector Database for Production RAG
summary: Compares managed and self-hosted vector databases on recall, cost and operational burden, with a decision matrix for production retrieval-augmented generation workloads.

title: Chunking Strategies That Actually Improve Retrieval Quality
summary: Benchmarks fixed-size, recursive, semantic and layout-aware chunking across three corpora, showing where each wins and how chunk overlap affects recall and cost.

title: How We Cut LLM Inference Costs by 60% With Model Routing
summary: A production account of routing requests between small and large models by task complexity, including the classifier design, the fallback ladder and the measured cost and latency deltas.

title: Evaluating RAG Systems: Metrics That Predict User Satisfaction
summary: Explains faithfulness, answer relevance and context precision, correlates each against human satisfaction scores, and provides a golden-dataset harness for regression testing.

title: Observability for LLM Agents: Tracing Multi-Step Reasoning
summary: Covers OpenTelemetry span design for agent pipelines, correlating structured logs with traces, and the intent-versus-outcome logging pattern for debugging tool selection failures.

title: Prompt Injection in Tool-Using Agents: Practical Defences
summary: Catalogues injection vectors against agents that browse and call tools, and evaluates input screening, tool allow-listing, and human confirmation gates as layered mitigations.

title: Human-in-the-Loop Patterns for Autonomous Agents
summary: Describes when to interrupt an agent for approval, how to design the approval payload so a reviewer can decide in seconds, and how to make confirmation gates tamper-resistant.

title: Context Window Management: Compaction, Summarisation and Caching
summary: Compares sliding windows, recursive summarisation and provider-side context caching for long-running agent sessions, with measured token and latency impact for each.
